executed_experiments.supported_claim: Actual Linux x64 .NET11/Rust1.100 native-thread callback, cancellation-registration drain, unique terminal/take and independent result-owner fixture: normal 10528 and Native AOT 10529 assertions; incremental Roslyn probe 9, static metadata restrictions 4 normal/6 AOT. Scope is research harness, not the complete product protocol.

Seven isolated Rust1.100 child cases: caught unwind and forgotten unknown payload survive; payload Drop, hook, cleanup-double-panic, extern-C escape, and panic=abort terminate as expected. No claim of full Engine recovery.

With runtime marshalling enabled, char/bool UCO publishes both normal and AOT, then native callback invocation terminates each isolated child (exit -6, unhandled InvalidProgramException) before callback body marker. Does not establish recovery by an outer managed catch or all invalid signatures.
